name: robbing-the-vault
description: Robbing the Vault — an on-chain heist game for the RobinVault (RVLT) token on Robinhood Chain. Prototype.

emblem_build._note: RETIRED 2026-09-15 (Jake): V1 permanently retired, never to be republished (pre-hardening leaky engine, security risk). Manifest repurposed to the V1 ARCHIVE tables so backup_artifact_db produces a durable, restorable V1-stats dump (.emblem_build/db-backup.sql) that never touches the live V2 tables. Historical record: 1918 runs, 108 players, Sep 7-13 2026, 1 core crack, 13.0955 ETH robbed, 945,500 RVLT burned, 3,135,448 RVLT won.

tables.name: rtv_runs_v1archive
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rtv_runs_v1archive (id INT, player TEXT, stake REAL, depth INT, outcome TEXT, won_rvlt REAL, burned_rvlt REAL, robbed_eth REAL, server_seed TEXT, server_hash TEXT, client_seed TEXT, ts TEXT, net INT)

tables.name: rtv_state_v1archive
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rtv_state_v1archive (id TEXT, jackpot_eth REAL, pot_rvlt REAL, burned_rvlt REAL, plays INT, robs INT, updated_at TEXT, seeded_rvlt REAL)

tables.name: rtv_door_picks_v1archive
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rtv_door_picks_v1archive (kind TEXT, net INT, n INT)

tables.name: rtv_visits_v1archive
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rtv_visits_v1archive (id TEXT, device TEXT, net INT, ts TEXT)

tables.name: rtv_arcade_pass_v1archive
tables.schema: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS rtv_arcade_pass_v1archive (wallet TEXT, tx TEXT, net INT, paid_at TEXT, fee_paid INT)
